summary: CLIMATRIX addresses the challenge by turning NASA Earth observation data into an interactive environmental learning experience for young people. We developed a website that transforms complex global environmental trends and Earth system data into accessible educational materials, including interactive maps, tables, and visualizations. Instead of simply presenting scientific data, our platform encourages young people to investigate environmental changes like detectives, understand global patterns, and explore the challenges facing our planet. To turn learning into active engagement, we integrated quizzes, missions, and a point-based scoring system that motivates users to test their knowledge, complete tasks, and take responsibility. By combining real NASA data, interactive tools, and gamified education, CLIMATRIX bridges the gap between scientific information and public awareness. Our solution responds to the challenge by making Earth science more understandable, engaging, and actionable, empowering the next generation to become informed and responsible participants in addressing global environmental issues.
details:
What Does Our Project Do?

CLIMATRIX is an interactive environmental education platform that transforms scientific data about Earth's changing systems into an engaging learning and discovery experience for young people. Our goal is not simply to inform users about environmental problems, but to help them understand the evidence, investigate global trends, develop a sense of responsibility, and become part of the solution.

How Does It Work?

Our website brings together scientific datasets and educational content from sources such as NASA GISTEMP, NASA sea-level observations, NOAA atmospheric CO₂ measurements, Our World in Data, and the World Bank. We transform complex information into accessible visual content through interactive maps, tables, charts, and educational materials. Users can explore environmental changes, compare information, and investigate the patterns behind global challenges.

The platform also includes quizzes, missions, and a point-based scoring system. Users earn points by testing their knowledge and completing educational tasks. This gamified approach encourages continuous participation and turns environmental learning into an active challenge rather than a passive reading experience.

Benefits and Expected Impact

CLIMATRIX aims to make reliable scientific information more accessible to young people, strengthen environmental literacy, and encourage informed decision-making. By combining education with interactive exploration and motivation, we aim to bridge the gap between knowing about environmental problems and understanding why individual and collective responsibility matters.

Our expected long-term impact is to inspire a generation that does not merely hear about global environmental challenges but actively investigates, understands, and takes responsibility for them.

Creativity and Innovation

Our main creative element is the combination of scientific investigation and gamified education. We approach young users as environmental detectives: instead of simply presenting them with facts, we encourage them to explore evidence, discover patterns, answer questions, and complete missions. The integration of NASA data into an accessible educational platform makes complex Earth science more approachable and engaging.

Tools and Team Considerations

We used web technologies, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, to develop our platform. We researched and incorporated scientific information from NASA, NOAA, Our World in Data, and the World Bank. During development, our team considered scientific credibility, data accessibility, ease of use, educational value, age-appropriate presentation, and user motivation. We aimed to create a platform that balances scientific information with simplicity, interaction, and meaningful participation.
